patch.summary: GetResponse migration guide: inventory → rehearse → freeze → validate integrations — grounded in researched limitations and catalogue peers.

blocks.body: Migrate to GetResponse by inventorying legacy email-marketing fields, mapping them to GetResponse objects, rehearsing a freeze window, and validating Shopify, Woocommerce, WordPress before reopening writes.
bullets: Inventory → map → rehearse → cut over → reopen
Highest risk: Starter limited to 1 custom automation workflow and capped AI generator uses
Success signal: email campaigns works for the pilot cohort

blocks.heading: GetResponse migration cutover playbook
blocks.body: Migrations fail from optimistic timelines — not from missing motivation.

scenarios.title: Field inventory
scenarios.body: Export legacy fields that power email campaigns, newsletter builder, email templates and mark must-map vs archive.

scenarios.title: Rehearsal load
scenarios.body: Run a non-prod load into GetResponse; measure match rates before the freeze.

scenarios.title: Production freeze
scenarios.body: Freeze legacy writes; cut over; validate Shopify; then reopen.

steps.label: Migrate when SMBs wanting email + automation + landing pages in one stack outweigh migration cost
Delay if this limitation hits cutover: Starter limited to 1 custom automation workflow and capped AI generator uses
If GetResponse mapping is poor, compare destination fit with Mailchimp before moving data twice

items.title: No freeze window
items.body: Dual-writing without a freeze creates irrevocable duplicates.

items.title: Integrations last
items.body: Wire Shopify in rehearsal — not on Monday morning after cutover.

items.title: Data risk 1
items.body: Starter limited to 1 custom automation workflow and capped AI generator uses

items.title: Data risk 2
items.body: Free plan heavily limited after 14-day premium window (branding, LP visits, automation filters)

items.title: Data risk 3
items.body: SMS, dedicated IP/domain, and some enterprise tools require Enterprise

checklist.label: Complete field inventory for email campaigns
Mitigate: Starter limited to 1 custom automation workflow and capped AI generator uses
